page.overview:
Who is Seer Ban'kosh?

Seer Ban'kosh was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto and the leader of a strange and secretive cult. Ban'kosh once led dozens of followers, but was trapped in the Anoat sector by the Imperial blockade during a "pilgrimage." He ended up joining the crew of the Smuggler.
